plugins.name: devplan
plugins.description: Product intelligence for software teams. Daily Radar, Demand Report, specs, engineering analytics, changelogs, stale commitments, suggested projects and customer release briefs, built from GitHub, Linear, Jira, Slack, Notion, Zendesk, Gong and more. Everything works on your own connections. Connect Devplan to run it all on a shared knowledge graph: faster, cheaper, always up to date, and the same for your whole team.
